nodes.label: download_voice.sh
nodes.description: Downloads Piper TTS voice models from HuggingFace. Accepts voice_id parameter (default: en_GB-alan-medium), parses locale/speaker/quality, downloads ONNX model and JSON metadata to ./voices directory

nodes.label: serve_vllm.sh
nodes.description: Starts vLLM OpenAI-compatible server with GPU-optimized flags. Configurable model, port, max context length, GPU utilization, and eager execution mode. Enables prefix caching for better performance

nodes.label: wait_for_vllm.sh
nodes.description: Health check script that polls vLLM /v1/models endpoint until ready. Accepts timeout parameter (default: 300s), polls every 2 seconds, exits 0 on success or 1 on timeout

nodes.label: JARVIS_TTS_VOICE
nodes.description: Path to Piper TTS voice ONNX model file. Set by download_voice.sh after downloading a voice model

nodes.label: JARVIS_LLM_MODEL
nodes.description: HuggingFace model identifier for vLLM inference server. Default: Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct

nodes.label: JARVIS_VLLM_PORT
nodes.description: Port number for vLLM OpenAI-compatible server. Default: 8000

nodes.label: JARVIS_VLLM_MAX_LEN
nodes.description: Maximum context length for vLLM model. Default: 8192

nodes.label: JARVIS_VLLM_GPU_UTIL
nodes.description: GPU memory utilization fraction for vLLM. Default: 0.85

nodes.label: JARVIS_VLLM_ENFORCE_EAGER
nodes.description: Force eager execution mode in vLLM (useful for large models on consumer GPUs). Default: false

nodes.label: JARVIS_LLM_BASE_URL
nodes.description: Base URL for vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Default: http://localhost:8000/v1

nodes.label: HuggingFace
nodes.description: HuggingFace model hub providing Piper voices and vLLM models

nodes.label: vLLM
nodes.description: High-performance LLM inference engine with OpenAI-compatible API
